2607.18589.title: Planning as Emergent Behavior in Reinforcement Learning with Relational Hidden States
2607.18589.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning is conventionally divided into model-based and model-free methods. In this taxonomy, model-based methods perform lookahead planning over a learned world model, whereas model-free methods learn a reactive state-action mapping. Recent work, however, has shown that planning can emerge from model-free reinforcement learning alone. The conditions under which this behavior emerges from a pure reward-maximization objective have so far remained unclear. In this paper, we present evidence that, in the observed cases, the hidden-state structure of the neural architecture is the deciding factor. We find that a network of relational hidden states, each anchored to an environment state and exchanging messages along learned relations, acquires a planning mechanism. These hidden states recover the environment's transition structure in their learned relations, and improve the policy at decision time by planning over the learned graph. In a matched control agent that must additionally discover which cells represent which states, no such binding arises, and no planning follows from it. We argue that this explains the observed phenomenon of emergent planning in model-free reinforcement learning and raises the question of how common such emergent planning might be more generally. Finally, we hypothesize that the discovered mechanism could describe how planning emerges from pure reward maximization in the human brain through a neural architectural prior.
2607.18589.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習通常分為基於模型和無模型的方法。在這一分類中，基於模型的方法在學習的世界模型上進行前瞻性規劃，而無模型的方法則學習反應性的狀態-行動映射。然而，最近的研究顯示，僅僅通過無模型強化學習也可以產生規劃。至今為止，這種行為從純獎勵最大化目標中出現的條件仍然不明確。在本文中，我們提供證據，顯示在觀察到的案例中，神經架構的隱藏狀態結構是決定性因素。我們發現，一個由關聯隱藏狀態組成的網絡，每個隱藏狀態都與環境狀態相連並沿著學習的關係交換信息，獲得了一種規劃機制。這些隱藏狀態在其學習的關係中恢復了環境的轉移結構，並通過在學習的圖上進行規劃來改善決策時的策略。在一個匹配的控制代理中，該代理還必須發現哪些單元代表哪些狀態，並未產生這樣的綁定，因此也沒有隨之而來的規劃。我們認為這解釋了在無模型強化學習中出現的規劃現象，並提出了這種出現的規劃在更一般情況下可能有多普遍的問題。最後，我們假設發現的機制可以描述規劃如何通過神經架構的先驗從純獎勵最大化中在人體大腦中出現。
2607.18589.author: Armin Sommer et.al.
